name: medieval_town_skyline
description: Muted brown-grey medieval town skyline: a crenellated town wall across the front (y -130..0) with a central gatehouse (two towers, dark arched gateway with a portcullis grid at x -48..48), steep-roofed half-timber houses with chimneys behind, a square keep on the left and a church with a plain pointed spire (no cross) right of centre, top at y -395. No flags, crosses, symbols or text. Bottom-centre anchor, about 1600x400.
